function.description: Retire an operator's blanket approval over one NFT collection (setApprovalForAll -> false). This can only REDUCE risk: it grants nothing and moves nothing. dry_run defaults to TRUE.
function.name: defi_trade_nft_revoke_approval

chain.description: Chain to nft_revoke_approval on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas differs by orders of magnitude, so a cent-scale trade can cost more in gas on ethereum than it is worth, while base is a fraction of a cent. Per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

operator.description: The operator whose blanket approval over this collection is retired. This can only REDUCE risk.
